_comment: Hand-resolved crosswalk collisions (TCGdex ja setId -> tcgcsv cat-85 groupId). These are sets where multiple tcgcsv groups share the release day AND the code conventions differ between the two sources, so tcgcsv-crosswalk.ts can't auto-pick. Resolved by matching the JP set name to the English tcgcsv name. Merged over the auto-crosswalk on every build.
